statement: For one frozen release-content digest, enforcing memory-soak evidence and every required local, packaging, container, Helm, release-workflow, and exact-SHA GitHub gate are green and independently reviewed.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Every local and remote receipt must bind to the same frozen release-content digest and exact committed SHA; any release-content edit invalidates closure.
memory-soak-enforcement-cutover must be terminal SOLVED, and the final soak must report analyzed true, at least 30 samples per node, no insufficient-analysis reason, and no detected leak.
Closure requires test:gate, test:ci, release-workflow contracts, npm package, all builds, Docker build/smoke, Helm render/package, final G1-G4 binding probes, and exact-SHA GitHub ci/gate receipts.
Verify GitHub permissions, Docker Hub variables/token, and npm publisher state, but do not publish or create v0.2.0 without separate outward-action authorization.
